aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab builds practical software for food trucks and mobile catering: online orders, pickup times and less hassle from the same questions. Founder: Dominic Bonini.
aboutPage.meta.title: About us — HatchGrab
aboutPage.story.build: We build practical software specifically for food trucks and mobile caterers — so they can take online orders, manage pickup times, keep orders running smoothly and spend less time answering the same questions.
aboutPage.story.change: HatchGrab was created to change exactly this.
aboutPage.story.fixedAddress: Yet most of the software available to them is made with fixed-address businesses in mind.
aboutPage.story.focus: Our aim is simple: make running a food truck easier, with tools built the way these businesses actually run.
aboutPage.story.start: HatchGrab started from a simple observation: food trucks need better tools to run their business.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: After creating Village Foodie — which helps people find food trucks coming to their area — I spent more time learning what problems mobile food businesses face. Unlike traditional restaurants, food trucks are always changing place, working at different locations and serving customers in changing conditions.

comparison.faq.capacityA: Customers only see the pickup times your kitchen can actually handle. The system works it out from each dish’s preparation time and how many you make at once.
comparison.faq.capacityQ: How does the system prevent too much pressure on my kitchen?
comparison.faq.costA: {plans}. Online card payments also carry Stripe’s fees: {cardFee} per card payment.
comparison.faq.costTrial: The first # month(s) free, with every feature.
comparison.faq.locationsA: Yes. You arrange your weekly schedule with places and times, and customers order for the place and day you will be there.
comparison.faq.locationsQ: Does it work even when the location changes?
comparison.faq.paymentsA: Customers pay online by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay, or pay at the truck at pickup. PayPal and Klarna are not supported for now.
comparison.faq.paymentsQ: Which payment methods does HatchGrab support?
comparison.faq.termA: No. There is no minimum term or notice period. You can cancel at any time; the fee is billed monthly in advance, and you keep access until the end of the month you have paid for.
comparison.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
comparison.faq.tseA: HatchGrab is not POS software and has no TSE. Ask your tax adviser how to record online orders in your POS.
comparison.faq.tseQ: Will I still need POS software with a TSE?
comparison.faq.whatA: An ordering system takes orders online before the customer reaches the truck: they choose the food and a pickup time, pay online or at pickup, and the order arrives in your kitchen. POS software or a card machine takes payment at the truck. The two complement each other.

featuresPage.detail.accountant_reports: Sales, tax and refunds for any month, quarter or tax year — ready to download for your accountant.
featuresPage.detail.advance_preordering: Let customers order for a future date or time before the event.
featuresPage.detail.auto_accept: Online orders are accepted automatically — no need to confirm each one separately.
featuresPage.detail.branded_qr_code: Add your logo to the QR code.
featuresPage.detail.buzzer_tracking: Put the pager number on the order when you hand one out, so you know which pager belongs to which order.
featuresPage.detail.customer_display: A screen customers can see — shows order numbers and when they are ready.
featuresPage.detail.discovery_map_listin: Your truck appears on HatchGrab’s public map, so customers nearby can find you.
featuresPage.detail.documents_reminders: Keep your certificates in one place — such as food hygiene, insurance and gas safety. We remind you before anything expires, and you can send them to an event or market organiser in one tap.
featuresPage.detail.embed_schedule: Show your upcoming dates on your own website. Each one goes straight to its order page.
featuresPage.detail.event_types: Create your own event types, with separate prices and settings for events and festivals.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_app: The most complete way to run HatchGrab: a live kitchen display, and the only way to keep taking orders when the signal drops.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_capacity: Set how much your kitchen can cook at once and how long it takes. Once a slot is full, customers can no longer choose it.
featuresPage.detail.loyalty_stamp_cards: Reward regular customers with digital stamp cards — collecting and redeeming stamps all happen automatically.
featuresPage.detail.meal_deals_upsells: Combine items into combos, and offer extra items at checkout — the average order amount goes up.
featuresPage.detail.messenger_instagram_: Just like WhatsApp auto-replies, for Messenger and Instagram questions.
featuresPage.detail.multi_device_kitchen: Run several screens — front counter and kitchen — all with the same live orders.
featuresPage.detail.multi_user_access: Give staff their own logins, with access as needed.
featuresPage.detail.offline_protection: If the signal drops, online ordering pauses, so customers can’t place orders you won’t see. On the iPhone, iPad and Android app you can take orders offline too; the web dashboard needs a connection.
featuresPage.detail.online_payments: Take card payment in advance through Stripe when customers order online.
featuresPage.detail.preorder_deadline: Set a last order time for items that need advance notice.
featuresPage.detail.private_events: Add private events that don’t show on the map, each with its own private order link and QR code.
featuresPage.detail.profit_per_event: Add what each dish costs and see how much profit you actually made at each event — not just the takings.
featuresPage.detail.qr_code: A printable QR code that opens your menu and order page.
featuresPage.detail.schedule_import: We fill in your schedule automatically — from your website, or from the picture you already post on Facebook. You just check and confirm.
featuresPage.detail.sms_order_alerts: Send the customer an SMS automatically when the order is ready.
featuresPage.detail.social_media_posts: Upload your designs — we add the dates, places and times for each week and every event automatically.
featuresPage.detail.sold_out_toggle: Mark any item ‘sold out’ in one tap — it turns grey for customers straight away.
featuresPage.detail.stock_countdown: Enter a stock count — it goes down as orders come in, then becomes ‘sold out’ by itself.
featuresPage.detail.tap_to_pay: Take card payments on a supported phone, no need for a separate card machine.
featuresPage.detail.ticket_printing: Print order tickets on a Bluetooth or wired printer in the kitchen.
featuresPage.detail.time_slot_selection: Customers choose a pickup time slot, so demand is spread across the whole service.
featuresPage.detail.walkup_orders: Take and manage orders right at the truck’s counter, take payment on your own card machine.
featuresPage.detail.web_dashboard: Run your service from the browser of any phone, tablet or laptop.

landing.does.capacityBody: Set how much you can cook at once and how long it takes. Once a pickup time is full, customers can no longer choose it.
landing.does.devicesBody: Runs on the phone in your apron pocket, the tablet on the counter, the laptop in the van — and also on the card machine you take payments on now.
landing.does.lede: Most ordering systems assume a fixed address, good wi-fi and the same hours every week. You are in a new place every week, at different times — sometimes a weak network, sometimes no network at all. HatchGrab was built exactly for that.
landing.does.offlineBody: If the signal drops, online ordering pauses by itself, so customers can’t place orders you won’t see. Keep taking orders on the iPhone, iPad and Android app.
landing.does.postsBody: Upload the design you post on Facebook or Instagram now. We will fill in the dates, places and times, ready to share — every week or every day.
landing.does.slotsBody: Customers order ahead and choose a pickup time. Shorter queues, and the food is ready as soon as they arrive.
landing.does.title: Built for food trucks, not for restaurants.
landing.does.whatsappBody: “Where are you tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” While you are on the way to your spot or busy at the grill, your WhatsApp still gets answered, using your own menu and schedule. Messenger and Instagram coming soon.
landing.does.whatsappSoonBody: “Where are you tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” Soon your WhatsApp will get answered even while you are on the way to your spot or busy at the grill. Messenger and Instagram after that.
